response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS circuitId, ci.country AS country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, ci.country), b AS (SELECT c.*, AVG(avg_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS baseline FROM c) SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round, avg_round - baseline AS diff FROM b ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Races are inner-joined to circuits, so races whose circuitId is missing from circuits are excluded. Each circuit is grouped by circuitId and country. The country baseline is the unweighted mean of its circuits' average rounds.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-break.
